question: After Arc 8, will the characters from the Empire stop appearing in the main story? I've grown attached to some of the characters from Arcs 7 and 8, so I'd be happy if they continued to appear.
answer:
They've certainly had a lot of screen time in Arcs 7 and 8, haven't they? From Volume 26 through the current Volume 37, that's twelve volumes in total... That's enough material for an entire series by itself (laughs).

Of course, I've grown attached to the characters as well. The frequency of their appearances will inevitably decrease, but saying they won't appear at all in the future would be a bit much. Abel would be far too ungrateful! He needs to repay Subaru for everything! (laughs)

So while it may be difficult for them to remain main characters, they'll still have appearances in the future. Please look forward to them!
